free.title: Snoopy in Style NYC
free.caption:
JUST OPENED · SNOOPY IN STYLE NYC

Ten designer zones, one free pop-up. The Meatpacking District's newest stop turns 75 years of Peanuts into a fashion exhibit, and it opened quietly on September 2.

Snoopy and Woodstock show up dressed by Diane von Furstenberg, Givenchy, Coach and Michael Kors Collection, next to rare archival sketches. Joe Cool's Listening Lounge spins the original Vince Guaraldi scores on vinyl, maybe the best five minutes in the building.

TIP
Go on a weekday morning. The High Line lunch crowd finds this fast, and the lounge gets loud once it does.

Closes September 26 and it is not coming back. Save it before your window closes.

📷 Timeout New York / Hyperallergic

food.title: Olly Olly Market
food.caption:
FOOD & MARKET · OLLY OLLY MARKET

Twelve kitchens, one smiley-face burger, zero group-chat arguments about where to eat. Olly Olly Market took over 17,000 square feet of the landmarked Starrett-Lehigh Building in Chelsea, and it's built for exactly the fight your friends have every week about dinner.

Moonburger, a Berlin doner counter, Thai from Kinn, wood-fired pizza and a full bar from Bar Avant all sit under one roof, so everyone orders what they actually want and you still end up at the same table.

TIP
Split a table and order from three counters instead of picking one. That's the entire point of a food hall.

Open daily except Sunday, with Bar Avant pouring until the kitchens close.

📷 Olly Olly Market

art.title: Masquerade
art.caption:
IMMERSIVE ART · MASQUERADE

You put on a mask, and the Opera Populaire builds itself around you. Masquerade turns The Phantom of the Opera into a walk-through night inside a transformed Midtown building, candlelit chambers and all, directed by Tony winner Diane Paulus.

Six Phantoms rotate the role, including Hugh Panaro, who has played the character over 2,000 times on Broadway. Every ticket includes the masquerade ball scene up close, the chandelier moment you've only ever watched from row M.

TIP
Book the earliest entry time you can find. Smaller groups move through the chambers with more room, and weeknights run well under the weekend price.

Running through January 2027, closed Mondays.

📷 Playbill / Oscar Ouk
